en: The regime begins with the qualification of the object. When what was offered is a governed enjoyment bundle sustained by continuous governance, and it can lose value without total rupture, the other parameters come into play. The preferred response is to restore the lost function, and monetary compensation remains a residual or complementary response.
This parameter thus functions as a trigger for the others.<1>p. 719</1>
Application is decided neither by technological intuition nor by automatic deference to the contract, but by the cumulative presence of verifiable elements of the regime<1>p. 429</1>
Monetization remains possible, but as a residual or complementary response, not as an automatic reflex of the injury.<1>p. 748</1>

Everything here was written to be understood without legal training, but beneath each sentence lies the text it came from. The mode selector, in the corner of the screen, changes the reading. Doctrine adds the concept entry and the guide for anyone who will defend a right, and Scholarship shows where each sentence came from and how each piece was built.

What brings the families together is the mechanism by which the user's experience is organized and remade, not the economic sector or the name of the service.
